name: sparkles

frames.best_why: Full starry field with the headline sitting cleanly on it; later frames only add a small cursor burst.

tagline: White specks drift upward on black, twinkling and sparking under the pointer.
summary: A full-bleed field of tiny white particles drifting upward while their brightness pulses. Moving the pointer pulls thin lines between nearby dots and a click adds a burst of new ones.
appearance: A black stage packed edge to edge with hundreds of small white dots of slightly varied size. Centred on top sits a faint uppercase eyebrow, a large white headline and a short two-line paragraph.
behaviour: Dots rise continuously while each one fades in and out, so the field sparkles. Bringing the pointer close draws faint lines to nearby dots, and clicking pushes a burst of particles outward before they resume drifting.
demo_content: Dark beta hero: eyebrow "Now in beta", headline "Ship something bright." and a two-line paragraph.
search_phrases: twinkling particle field for a hero
interactive particles that follow the cursor
animated particle canvas for landing page
use_when: A launch or beta hero needs a living backdrop that reacts to the pointer without competing with the headline.
avoid_when: The loop never idles and ignores reduced-motion, costing battery; touch devices get no hover.
customise: Density, dot size, speed, drift direction, colour, opacity and the hover and click modes are props; grab-line and burst tuning needs a source edit.
weight_why: A canvas loop redraws up to 1200 dots and their opacity every frame with no pause.

a11y.note: The decorative canvas has no role or text alternative and the animation ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: The recorded demo places its headline outside the component, so the shipped piece is only the backdrop.
The small paragraph at 60% white is faint against the moving dots.
polish_why: Clean particle field, but the twinkling-dots-behind-a-headline pairing is a familiar template.
